title: Michigan gave schools $224M for infrastructure, but they need billions
summary_en: Michigan is one of eight states where bonds are the primary funding source for school infrastructure costs, researchers found. The state recently awarded grants, but public schools still need $22.8 billion in repairs.
author: Matt Mencarini
title_cn: Michigan gave schools $224M for infrastructure, but they need billions

title: Michigan college students struggle with housing, food. Program aims to help
summary_en: Students at Henry Ford College and Wayne State University with basic needs will have access to a United Way official to direct them to resources on and off campus.
author: Kim Kozlowski
title_cn: Michigan college students struggle with housing, food. Program aims to help
